k:敏.mnemonic: Every (毎) time you strike (攵) at the fly, it has already moved. Quick wits beat a quick hand. Cleverness (agile, alert).

k:飼.mnemonic: A farmer in a straw hat (𠆢) holds food to the mouth (口) of a stubborn (艮) wild goat every day, until at last it will eat (食) from his hand. Domesticate (raise, keep, feed).

k:胞.mnemonic: For month (月) after month before it is born, the baby is kept in a soft wrap (包) inside its mother. Placenta (sac, sheath).

k:賃.mnemonic: Even the leader (亻), even the king (王), must hand the ferryman a shellfish (貝) coin before stepping aboard. Fare (fee, hire, rent).
k:賃.hint: Even the king pays the ferryman.

k:凡.mnemonic: A plain table (几) with one drop (丶) of spilled tea on it. There is nothing else to remark on. Mediocre (commonplace, ordinary).

k:暑.mnemonic: A day (日) so hot and heavy that the village elder (耂) will not leave the shade, and sits fanning himself until dark. Sultry (hot, summer heat).
k:暑.hint: Elder fanning himself in the shade.

k:翼.mnemonic: Feathers (羽) held together (共) in one broad sheet. The heron lifts off from the edge of the well (井) and its shadow crosses the rice field (田). Wing (plane, flank).
k:翼.hint: Feathered sheet lifting off the well.

k:顧.mnemonic: Before you employ (雇) someone, turn to the previous page (頁) of their record and see what they did before. Look back (review, examine oneself, turn around).

k:勉.mnemonic: No excuse (免) is accepted. Put all your power (力) into it and keep going until the work is done. Exertion (endeavour, encourage, strive).

k:亭.mnemonic: A small garden house whose roof juts like a forehead (冖) over one open side, a mouth (口) where guests sit and sip tea. Pavilion (restaurant, mansion, arbor).
k:亭.hint: Garden house with one open side.

k:慣.mnemonic: The first time the needle is about to pierce (貫) your skin, your heartbeat (忄) races. By the tenth it stays perfectly steady. Accustomed (get used to, become experienced).

k:廷.mnemonic: A samurai (士) takes one long stride (廴) after another down the great hall to kneel before the king (王). Courts (imperial court, government office).

k:裂.mnemonic: A file (列) of people all pull on the same garment (衣) from both ends, until it rips straight down the middle. Split (rend, tear).
k:裂.hint: Tug of war over a robe.

k:暫.mnemonic: The car (車) has broken an axle, so for one day (日) an axe (斤) handle is wedged in its place. It will do for now. Temporarily (a while, moment).
k:暫.hint: Axe handle standing in for an axle.

k:慎.mnemonic: Someone who knows the true (真) size of things keeps a quiet heartbeat (忄) and does not boast. Humility (be careful, discreet, prudent).

k:汽.mnemonic: Boil a tsunami (氵) of water in the kettle and it rises as white vapor (气), strong enough to drive an engine. Vapor (steam).
k:汽.hint: Kettle cloud that drives an engine.

k:眺.mnemonic: The eye (目) is fixed on the horizon, unblinking, searching the clouds for a portent (兆). Stare (watch, look at, scrutinize).

k:罰.mnemonic: Caught in the net (罒), the thief hears the judge say (言) the sentence: his proud long hair is to be cut off with a knife (刂). Penalty (punishment).
k:罰.hint: Judge's sentence for the netted thief.

k:該.mnemonic: The clerk points back up the page. This is the very person (人) I did say (言) a moment ago, the one already named. Above-stated (the said, that specific).

k:彰.mnemonic: A badge (章) polished with a brush of whiskers (彡) until it gleams. Nobody can miss whose merit it shows. Patent (clear).

k:悟.mnemonic: The monk sits until all five (五) senses fall quiet, his mouth (口) shut, hearing only his own heartbeat (忄). Then, suddenly, he understands. Enlightenment (perceive, discern, realize).

k:踊.mnemonic: The leg (足) has one task (用): to spring. Slip the muzzle (マ) off the dog and it bounds straight up into the air. Jump (dance, leap, skip).

k:瞬.mnemonic: A cow (牛) watches dancing legs (舛) go by. Beneath its forehead (冖) one eye (目) shuts and opens again, quick as the swipe of a cat's claw (爪). Wink (blink, twinkle).
k:瞬.hint: Cow's eye shuts for an instant.

k:憶.mnemonic: An idea (意) from long ago comes back to you and your heartbeat (忄) skips, just as it did then. Recollection (think, remember, thought).

k:紫.mnemonic: Stir the thread (糸) in the dye pot with a spoon (匕), and stop (止) the moment it turns the colour of emperors. Purple (violet).
k:紫.hint: Dye pot at the emperor's colour.

k:網.mnemonic: Thread (糸) knotted into a hood (冂) of mesh and hung over the bed, so that every mosquito ends up deceased (亡) on the outside. Netting (network).

k:訟.mnemonic: Say (言) your complaint in public (公), in front of a judge, and demand what you are owed. Sue (accuse).

k:召.mnemonic: A mouth (口) speaking words so smooth that the guard lays down his sword (刀) and comes when he is called. Seduce (call, send for, wear).

k:屈.mnemonic: They lower the flag (尸) and file out through the exit (出) with heads bowed. The castle is given up. Yield (bend, flinch, submit).

k:脈.mnemonic: An axe (斤) splits the rock under the overhang (厂) and a line of silver runs through it. After a month (月) of digging they are still following it. Vein (pulse, hope).
